meta.title: 发一下今天的审美学习作业
meta.topic: 审美学习 · 搭配启发

scenes.title_en: The Highlight: A Red Bag and Two-Tone Umbrella
scenes.context: 第一张图：亮点是正红色的包包和黄蓝拼色的雨伞，两个构成了出片的视觉焦点。穿搭参考：把小格子的衬衫系在腰间，有很松弛的街头感。语域：审美讲解，图片分析。
sentences: 这张图的亮点是正红色的包和黄蓝拼色伞。
The highlights: the bright red bag and the yellow-blue umbrella.
the bright red bag（正红色的包）
这两个构成了出片的视觉焦点。
They form the visual focus of the shot.
the visual focus（视觉焦点）
格子衬衫系在腰间，有街头感。
A plaid shirt tied at the waist adds street flair.
street flair（街头感）
paraphrase: 视觉焦点 → the visual focus / the eye-catcher
街头感 → street flair / a casual urban vibe
scenes.speak: The highlights: the bright red bag and the yellow-blue umbrella. They form the visual focus of the shot. A plaid shirt tied at the waist adds street flair.

scenes.title_en: Color Lesson: Cool Base, Warm Accents
scenes.context: 第二张图的灵感在配色：衬衫和半裙都选偏冷色调，半裙颜色和衬衫细条纹一致；但鞋子和包包选了暖色，形成冷暖对撞。银色表带和身上主体的冷色穿搭很和谐。语域：审美讲解，配色分析。
sentences: 衬衫和半裙，都选偏冷色调。
The shirt and skirt both lean cool-toned.
lean cool-toned（偏冷色调）
鞋和包选暖色，形成冷暖对撞。
Warm shoes and bag create a cool-warm clash.
a cool-warm clash（冷暖对撞）
银色表带，和冷色穿搭很和谐。
The silver strap harmonizes with the cool outfit.
harmonizes with（和谐）
paraphrase: 冷暖对撞 → a cool-warm clash / warm-cold contrast
scenes.speak: The shirt and skirt both lean cool-toned. Warm shoes and bag create a cool-warm clash. The silver strap harmonizes with the cool outfit.

scenes.context: 克莱因蓝的鞋子+白色发圈是亮点；背景撞色拍照更出片。餐厅拍照可以找和背景有撞色效果的亮色物品：粉紫色菜单撞蓝白格纹桌布，更妙的是和身后薄荷绿画撞色。红紫配薄荷绿是今夏流行的吸睛配色。语域：审美讲解，拍照技巧。
sentences: 克莱因蓝的鞋和白色发圈，是亮点。
The Klein blue shoes and white scrunchie are the highlights.
Klein blue（克莱因蓝）
找亮色物品，和背景撞色。
Find bright items that clash with the background.
clash with the background（和背景撞色）
红紫配薄荷绿，今夏很吸睛。
Red-purple with mint green is this summer's eye-catcher.
eye-catcher（吸睛）
scenes.speak: The Klein blue shoes and white scrunchie are the highlights. Find bright items that clash with the background. Red-purple with mint green is this summer's eye-catcher.

scenes.context: 眼妆启发：这个女生的腮红和口红是同色系的，鼻尖和下巴都打了腮红。最细节的点是用腮红在下眼睑靠近睫毛根部的地方带点粉色，那一笔很有氛围感，整个妆有楚楚可怜的感觉。语域：审美讲解，妆面分析。
sentences: 腮红和口红，用同色系。
The blush and lipstick share the same color family.
the same color family（同色系）
鼻尖和下巴，都打上腮红。
Blush lands on the nose tip and chin.
blush lands（打腮红）
下眼睑带一点粉，很有氛围感。
A hint of pink under the lash line adds mood.
adds mood（有氛围感）
paraphrase: 同色系 → the same color family / matching tones
scenes.speak: The blush and lipstick share the same color family. Blush lands on the nose tip and chin. A hint of pink under the lash line adds mood.

practice: They form the visual focus of the shot.
Warm shoes and bag create a cool-warm clash.
Find bright items that clash with the background.
The blush and lipstick share the same color family.
pitfalls: The bag is the focal point.
They form the visual focus of the shot.
「视觉焦点」用 the visual focus，不是 focal point。
Warm shoes and bag create a cool-warm clash.
A hint of pink under the lash line adds mood.
The shirt and skirt both lean cool-toned.
shifts: 用 street flair（街头感）、tied at the waist（系腰间）、lean cool-toned（偏冷色）
用 a cool-warm clash（冷暖对撞）、the same color family（同色系）、harmonize（和谐）
用 the visual focus（视觉焦点）、eye-catcher（吸睛）、clash with the background（背景撞色）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：剩→剩（只）、接头感→街头感、腾衫→衬衫、暖嘴状→暖中带撞、805鞋→板鞋、低发→低盘发、画眼妆、处处可怜→楚楚可怜、下眼瞼→下眼睑、同色系、薄荷绿、克莱因蓝、粉紫色菜单等。
